issue: Re-verified current (covers both trains T1 and T2). The Balhaf LNG export plant has been shut since Yemen LNG declared force majeure in April 2015 amid the war; foreign personnel were evacuated and the feed-gas pipeline was damaged (June 2019) and remains out of service. TotalEnergies and partners continue to finance the site at a loss to preserve it but state operations cannot safely resume given the security/political situation. No restart or export resumption found through 2025-26. GEM Status mothballed (actual) with StopYear 2015 is correct for both T1 and T2; owner Yemen LNG Company Ltd and the parent shareholder list (TotalEnergies 39.6%, SK, KOGAS, Hyundai, GASSP, Hunt, Yemen Gas Co) are consistent.
